assertions.basis: sedi-1 issuer-issues: An issuer issues exactly the credentials a request asks for, each under a blindable registry of its own, with its own keys, salts and clock; it refuses, and never issues something else, a request whose attributes a credential's schema does not allow once the issuer has added the block's d, u and i, or whose edges cannot hold as the request's roles issue the credentials. sedi-1 seal-shape: A seal anchoring a registry event is the couple {s, d}, or the event seal {i, s, d} whose i is the registry's SAID; an i naming anything else, an extra field and a bare digest are refused. sedi-1 tel-sequence: A registry event's sequence number n is its predecessor's plus one, and the inception's is 0.
assertions.note: What is issued is verified, and compared with what was asked only after what legitimately varies is set aside (this.i 2u2ps8mt).

description: As SI-01, but the credential names no issuee, so its attribute block carries no i. A sedi-1 issuer issues it.
title: An untargeted credential
